description.p: Semibreve adds an output device called Semibreve to PipeWire. Everything played through it passes through FxSound's audio engine, with the same effects, presets and tuning as FxSound on Windows, and then on to your speakers or headphones.
The DSP is not a reimplementation: it is FxSound's own C source, built for Linux, with the changes Linux needed kept to the edges.

ul.li: FxSound's five effects: Fidelity, Ambience, Surround, Dynamic Boost and Bass
A choice of output device; unplug it and the sound moves to another, then comes back when you plug it in again
A power button and a tray icon showing whether processing is on
Starting it routes your audio through it, and quitting puts your audio back where it was
Settings are remembered, and survive the audio engine restarting
